title: Coordinator adoption notes and release
goal: A coordinator with its own order and overview tools can move to the shipped ones
acceptance: Profile and refresh docs describe the shipped sections; CHANGELOG reconcile step: move the order file to the shipped format and drop project tools it replaces
check:template, test:tools and check:rule-load pass; release entry names skills to re-read
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A step a coordinator cannot follow without editing a copied tool is a design defect here

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement.
